mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.health_examination_batches WHERE id=#{batchId} AND organization_id=#{organizationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL)
SELECT batch_participant_id, batch_service_id FROM public.health_examination_participant_services WHERE is_performed AND batch_participant_id IN #{id} ORDER BY batch_participant_id, batch_service_id

SELECT FROM public.health_examination_batch_participants p JOIN public.health_examination_batch_days d ON d.batch_id=p.batch_id AND d.id=p.batch_day_id WHERE p.batch_id=#{batchId} AND p.roster_status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY d.examination_date ASC, p.participant_code ASC NULLS LAST, p.full_name ASC, p.id ASC

SELECT ps.batch_participant_id, ps.batch_service_id FROM public.health_examination_participant_services ps JOIN public.health_examination_batch_participants p ON p.batch_id=ps.batch_id AND p.id=ps.batch_participant_id WHERE ps.batch_id=#{batchId} AND ps.is_performed AND p.roster_status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY ps.batch_participant_id, ps.batch_service_id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS registered, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE attendance_status='UNCONFIRMED') AS unconfirmed, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE attendance_status='ATTENDED') AS attended, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE attendance_status='ABSENT') AS absent, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE service_reconciliation_status='RECONCILED') AS reconciled, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE attendance_status='ATTENDED' AND service_reconciliation_status='PENDING') AS pending_reconciliation FROM public.health_examination_batch_participants WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND roster_status='ACTIVE'

SELECT ps.batch_service_id, ps.unit_price_snapshot AS unit_price, COUNT(*) AS examined_count FROM public.health_examination_participant_services ps JOIN public.health_examination_batch_participants p ON p.batch_id=ps.batch_id AND p.id=ps.batch_participant_id WHERE ps.batch_id=#{batchId} AND ps.is_performed AND p.roster_status='ACTIVE' GROUP BY ps.batch_service_id, ps.unit_price_snapshot ORDER BY ps.batch_service_id, ps.unit_price_snapshot
